source: Valve, Counter-Strike 2 update posts on Steam (steam_community_announcements)

updates.title: Cobblestone clean-up after its return
points: Cobblestone: closed a spot in the Princess tower where the bomb could be thrown out of reach.
Cobblestone: fixed bad wallbangs, boosts, walkable ledges and gaps, plus smoother movement across the map.
Cobblestone: grenades no longer fall through the world at one spot on B.
Third-person silent reload animations now play at the right speed.
updates.matters: Cobblestone is new in matchmaking again, so expect more fixes like these for a while.

updates.title: Inferno B grenade exploit closed, more Cobblestone fixes
points: Inferno: closed a grenade and molotov exploit spot from Church to Dark on B site.
Cobblestone: fixed walkable ledges in Long A, an empty skybox, an audio blocker near mid/A, and added a grenade clip to the van bumper.
New slow (silent) reload animation for the AWP.
Players in Switzerland now open containers through an X-Ray Scanner in the inventory.
updates.matters: If you used a throw from Church into Dark on Inferno B, test it again in practice before you rely on it.

updates.title: Singapore Major hub, Cobblestone back in matchmaking
points: The PGL Singapore 2026 Major hub is live: tournament items, Pick’Em and a Viewer Pass with an upgradable coin and a leaderboard.
Cobblestone joins Casual, Competitive, Wingman, Retakes and Deathmatch; Boulder, Fachwerk and Shelter leave official matchmaking.
Eight new Monstercat music kits.
Fixes: head dipping at extreme aim angles, the T-side lowered aim pose, defuse kits in Retakes, and T bots now attack CTs who defuse.

updates.title: Animation and stability fixes
points: Less popping when you switch weapons or reload at extreme angles.
Fixed bot pathing in Retakes and a rendering hang on DirectX 11.
Better detection of AVX and AVX-512 processors, plus stability and performance work.

updates.title: Faster Retakes, pet chicken tricks
points: Retakes: the defuse now finishes instantly when there is enough time and no utility left that could stop it; freeze time and the restart delay are shorter.
Ping your pet chicken during freeze time and it does a trick; its name is hidden when custom item text is set to hidden.
Map scripting for Workshop creators was reorganised around a new Entities export, with hooks for bot control.

updates.title: Silent reload: hold or toggle
points: New setting: silent reload can work as Hold or Toggle. With Toggle you can let go of the key once it starts; tap reload again to switch back to a fast reload.
The first sound of a reload no longer leaks when you asked for a silent one.
Fixed liquid rendering black on AMD cards and some demo-rewind bugs.
updates.matters: If holding reload in a clutch feels awkward, switch silent reload to Toggle.

updates.title: Big map scripting update for Workshop creators
points: New scripting tools for custom maps: asset precaching, hostage events, reading and setting console variables, and game rules such as warmup, team score and ending a round.
Radar elements can now appear in every game mode, not only Rush.
Script warnings are more detailed and show the call stack.

updates.title: A better demo viewer
points: Demo and replay downloads show a progress bar.
The camera uses click-and-drag, and the free and chase cameras work while a demo is paused.
Seeking in a demo is more reliable.
AUG reload animations now match the shorter reload, and the list of allowed radio commands is explicit.
updates.matters: Reviewing your own demos got easier: pause and fly the camera to check where everyone stood.

updates.title: AUG reloads half a second faster
points: The AUG reload is half a second shorter.
Dropped defuse kits get a ping icon.
Fixed the Desert Eagle sound during a silent reload and buzzing ambient sounds in demos.
updates.matters: A faster reload makes the AUG a little better in long CT fights.

updates.title: Manage Workshop maps from the Play menu
points: New Play menu buttons to manage the Workshop maps you downloaded.
Pet photobook pages have localized text.
A shader cache tweak for the Vulkan renderer.

updates.title: Grenade crosshair fix, better Warehouse lighting
points: The grenade crosshair now draws correctly with a thickness of 3 pixels.
Agents wear their equipped gloves in the photo booth and the buy menu.
Better lighting on Warehouse, and Workshop maps accept the new crosshair settings.

updates.title: Grenade crosshair in freeze time for insta-smokes
points: Hold any grenade attack button during freeze time to see the grenade crosshair — made for lining up insta-smokes.
New crosshair options: outline colour, a Static Quadrant style and negative gaps for the classic dynamic style.
The crosshair share code changed format and now includes your scope dot settings.
The display of weapon inaccuracy and spread was fixed.
updates.matters: Insta-smokes are easier to aim before the round starts: hold the throw button and line up with the grenade crosshair.

updates.title: Rush map fixes
points: Closed pixel gaps in several Rush rooms.
Clipping changes in the T and CT Castle rooms.

updates.title: Rush fixes and a clan tag switch for servers
points: More gap and clipping fixes in Rush.
Loud reload sounds no longer carry over when you try to reload silently.
Community servers can turn clan tags off with a new setting.

updates.title: Silent reload tricks removed
points: Closed a trick that gave a slightly faster silent reload by tapping before holding the key.
Silent reload can no longer make shotguns fire faster.
Rush shows its rules on the loading screen and changes when players are kicked for team damage.

updates.title: Rush timing changes and crosshairs in pixels
points: Rush: the countdown after an elimination grows from 7 to 14 seconds in end rooms and on Convoy, and does not start when a team dies to suicides, team kills or disconnects; warmup, freeze time and timeouts are shorter.
Crosshair thickness, length and gap are now set in pixels and scale with your resolution automatically.
New half-outline option and a static square style; dynamic styles use a 64-pixel baseline for spread.
Clan tags show in the kill feed.
updates.matters: Your crosshair numbers now mean pixels — check your crosshair again after changing resolution or loading an old setup.

updates.title: New Premier map pick, Rush mode, silent reload and new crosshairs
points: Premier map choice changed: Team 1 picks a map, Team 2 picks two, Team 1 picks one more, and one of the four is drawn at random.
New 3v3 mode, Rush: fight through random arenas to the enemy castle and hold the tower to win the round.
Hold reload to reload silently but slowly; un-scoping a sniper is silent; bullet impact decals are clearer.
ammo_grenade_limit_total now also limits how many grenades you can buy in a round.
Crosshairs no longer depend on resolution, live in a new Crosshair/Scopes tab and default to the Dynamic Quad style.
Map fixes on Ancient (grenade clipping in Jaguar), Cache, Mirage and Train; clan tags for Steam groups and stickers on the C4.
updates.matters: You will play the maps your team picked more often in Premier, so a small map pool you know well pays off even more.

updates.title: Cache fixes, chat hidden in demos
points: Cache: fixed gaps and a wallbang spot on B, added a missing competitive CT spawn and more T spawns.
Chat is encrypted in demos again: team chat cannot be read, and all chat only shows when you watch through the in-game viewer.
Custom camera and HUD scripting tools were reworked for map makers.

updates.title: Custom HUD and camera tools for Workshop maps
points: Scripted maps can show their own interface with a new custom HUD entity styled with CSS.
A new player camera entity can control a player’s view without moving them.
New script events around planting and defusing the bomb, plus better error logging.

updates.title: Community map updates, wall speed fix
points: Boulder and Poseidon updated to their latest Workshop versions.
Fixed a case where players moved too fast while running against walls.

updates.title: Fachwerk and Shelter updated
points: Fachwerk and Shelter updated to their latest Workshop versions.

updates.title: Grenades no longer pass through walls, Cache fixes
points: Fixed a case where grenades could be thrown through level geometry.
Cache: fixed gaps, collision and flickering assets, and removed a boost spot in Outside A.
New grenade and bomb events for map scripting.
updates.matters: If a lineup only worked by slipping through a wall, it is gone — re-test any odd-looking throws.

updates.title: Cologne Major stickers, VACnet fix
points: Cologne 2026 Ranked Series stickers on sale, with half of the royalties going to players, teams and the organiser; the Cologne shop stays open until September 29.
Closed a bug that let some players avoid VACnet.
Boulder, Fachwerk and Shelter updated to their latest Workshop versions.

updates.title: C4 explosion now affects smokes and molotovs
points: The C4 explosion now interacts with smoke clouds and molotov or incendiary fire.
The bomb damage health preview appears once the bomb becomes audible.
Fachwerk, Boulder and Debris updated to their latest Workshop versions.
updates.matters: A post-plant smoke or molotov right next to the bomb will be blown away when it explodes — plan the last seconds of a retake with that in mind.

updates.title: Community map updates
points: Fachwerk, Boulder, Shelter and El Dorado updated to their latest Workshop versions.
Stability and security fixes.

updates.title: Follow-up fixes to the new C4 damage
points: The new C4 explosion no longer deals a minimum of one damage across the whole map.
Fixed wrong C4 damage near the borders between map areas.
The explosion pushes dropped weapons harder.

updates.title: Premier Season Five: Cache in, Overpass out, new C4 damage
points: Premier Season Five starts. Cache joins the Active Duty map pool and Overpass leaves it.

C4 explosion damage was redesigned on all official defusal maps: it follows precomputed values baked into each map, and the shockwave spreads out from the centre instead of hitting everywhere at once.
Community maps: Warden, Stronghold, Alpine and Sanctum removed; Boulder, Fachwerk and Shelter added to Competitive, Casual and Deathmatch; Debris and El Dorado added to Wingman.
New weapon and sticker collections, a Source 2 engine update, and clipping fixes on Cache, Dust II and Inferno.
updates.matters: Cache is a competitive map again — it is worth learning its standard smokes now. Where you stand at the explosion matters more than before.

updates.title: Cologne Major champions stickers
points: Champions autograph stickers for the Cologne 2026 winners, Falcons, are on sale in the Major Shop.
Highlight souvenir charms with 10 highlights from each stage of the Major.

updates.title: Major Shop price history, Storage Unit multi-select
points: The Cologne 2026 Major Shop shows the lowest and highest sticker price of the last 7 days.
Storage Units let you select several items at once.
Clearer errors when your inventory is full.

updates.title: Spectator flash setting, Ancient boost fix
points: A new setting controls how strong flashbangs look to remote spectators, and the effect now draws under the HUD.
Ancient: clipping changed to remove some boost spots.
Sanctum updated and stickers can be bookmarked in the Cologne shop.

updates.title: Cologne Major hub, souvenirs in trade-ups
points: The IEM Cologne 2026 Major hub opened with Pick’Em and a Viewer Pass coin.
Souvenir items can now be used in a Trade Up Contract; their souvenir attributes are removed and the result is a normal item.
Spectators see a stronger in-eye flash, and overtime shows correctly on the scoreboard timeline.

updates.title: Cache collision and footstep fixes
points: Cache: player and grenade collision adjusted, and surface materials changed so footsteps sound right.
Cache and Ancient: gaps reported by players were closed.
updates.matters: Grenade collision on Cache changed — re-check Cache lineups you learned before May 20.

updates.title: More consistent jump-throws
points: Grenade jump-throws are more consistent, and the jump-throw preview camera is more accurate.
A new setting applies ladder inaccuracy to players boosted on top of a stack of two or more players.
Cache: window covers now show hits, with new player and grenade clipping around windows and the vent.
Spectating fixes and new money and player script functions for map makers.
updates.matters: Good news for lineups: jump-throws land more consistently, and the preview camera now shows a truer landing spot.

updates.title: Cache windows block bullets, grenade cancel bug fixed
points: Cache: grating added to some windows so they block bullets; holes, surface types and player and grenade clipping fixed.
You can no longer cancel a grenade throw that already started at the end of the pin pull.
New MVP anthem variant for the NIGHTMODE II music kits.

updates.title: Cache polish, NIGHTMODE II music kits
points: Cache: holes fixed, grenade clipping simplified in several areas, sounds and surface types fixed.
NIGHTMODE II music kits on sale in the store.
Your viewmodel field of view now shows correctly to other players; smoother landing and post-processing transitions.
Map guides for night-time Ancient load again; Deathmatch weapon scores and XP limits adjusted.
updates.matters: Simpler grenade clipping on Cache can change where a smoke bounces — test Cache lineups after this update.

updates.title: Cache clipping and bomb spots, aim punch capped
points: Cache: map-wide clipping and geometry fixes, and the dropped bomb can no longer land out of reach in some spots.
Aim punch is limited to 90 degrees.
No more hand popping when you counter-strafe with a grenade out.
Fixed a shader compile crash on some older GPUs.

updates.title: Cache reworked in many spots, Xbox corner blocked
points: Cache: bigger bomb explosion radius, a reworked e-box on A, a lower Checkers frame at B Main, the AC unit above Sandbags removed, wallbangs on A Main fixed, and grenade and player clipping adjusted across the map.
Dust II: you can no longer see through the corner of Mid Box (Xbox).
More consistent smoke lighting and a possible fix for all audio dropping out.
updates.matters: Grenade clipping changed all over Cache one day after it arrived — Cache lineups made before April 29 need a re-check.

updates.title: Cache arrives in matchmaking, Xbox jump spot is back
points: Cache added to Competitive, Casual, Deathmatch and Retakes.
Dust II: Mid Box (Xbox) was opened up again to bring back a hidden jump spot — on purpose this time, Valve says.
Office: the tarp on the boxes near CT spawn now has collision; Stronghold and Poseidon updated.
Talon and Karambit knives are held correctly while defusing.

updates.title: Animation fixes, map guides match new ground smoothing
points: Many animation fixes: Dual Berettas, foot placement, stutter steps, legs snapping and the third-person bomb plant.
Official map guides were adjusted to the new surface smoothing.
Dropped silenced weapons show the silencer correctly; fixed a startup crash with a non-default audio device.
updates.matters: Map guides were updated for the new ground smoothing — use the current guides, not screenshots from before April.

updates.title: Thin ledges smoothing, trade offers capped
points: Ground smoothing adjusted where you can stand on very thin ledges.
Trade offers with CS2 items are limited to 1,000 items.

updates.title: Recoil camera feels like CS:GO again
points: Camera movement from recoil now matches CS:GO more closely, while bullets still fly as in CS2.
You now feel the full camera kick when you get shot, whatever your ping; the effect on bullets is still applied right away on the server.
Fixed instant crouch transitions in the air.

updates.title: Burst fire delay restored
points: Fixed a bug that removed the delay between bullets in burst fire.

updates.title: New animation system goes live for everyone
points: Every change from the Animgraph 2 beta is now in the main game.
Closed a trick that let players climb ladders silently at run speed.
Ground smoothing adjusted where slopes meet flat ground; held grenades keep the right size after being dropped and picked up.
Fixed a halftime crash when switching from CT to T.
updates.matters: Animgraph 2 changes player height on slopes (see April 1) — lineups thrown from a ramp may land differently now.

updates.title: Animgraph 2 beta: HE throw and planting fixes
points: Beta build only: fixed the HE grenade throw animation, idle foot placement and turn animations while planting.
Fixed fast weapon switching while holding inspect and adjusted the head dip when counter-strafing.

updates.title: Animgraph 2 beta: pose and switch fixes
points: Beta build only: fixed wrong poses when backing into corners, stutter in third-person aim and pops when switching weapons after a grenade throw.
Fixed a way to climb down ladders faster than before.

updates.title: Animgraph 2 beta: less network traffic
points: Beta build only: lower network bandwidth use.

updates.title: Animgraph 2 beta: new animations and consistent height on slopes
points: A new animation system, Animgraph 2, arrives in a beta build: all third-person animations were re-made and cost less CPU and network.
Player height on ramps is now the same whichever way you walk onto them — and Valve warns that grenade lineups thrown from slopes may have changed.
Players no longer show through thin walls when none of their body is visible, thanks to a GPU visibility check.
Sound mix changes to make jump landings easier to hear in a fight, and a new C4 equip sound.
updates.matters: If a lineup starts on a ramp or slope, test it again — your eye height there may have changed since April.

updates.title: Reloads now drop the magazine, map guides in Competitive
points: Reloading a magazine weapon now throws away the bullets left in the magazine and takes a full new one from your reserve, which is shown as magazines, shells or bullets.
Reserve magazine counts were tuned per weapon, and the fill level of your magazine shows under the ammo count.
Map guides are allowed in Competitive and Retakes in a limited form: the first 5 rounds of each half and up to 30 nodes. Simple starter guides were added for every Active Duty map.
You can join friends playing a Practice or Workshop map from the friends menu if their party is open.
updates.matters: Reload less out of habit — every early reload now costs you bullets. And you can bring a small set of lineups into Competitive through map guides.

updates.title: X-Ray Scanner for Germany and the Netherlands
points: In Germany and the Netherlands containers can only be opened through an X-Ray Scanner in the inventory, which comes with a free non-tradable P250 | X-Ray.
Keyless containers such as souvenir packages open as before.

updates.title: Dead Hand Collection
points: The Dead Hand Collection: 17 community finishes and 22 new gloves as rare special items, opened through the Dead Hand Terminal from weekly drops.
Dust II: closed a pixel gap in a door Outside Long; Alpine updated.
